title: WRRA Cross Domain 1.0 Comparative Exact Validation in Games Power Grids and Scheduling
description: WRRA Cross Domain 1.0 tests one fixed execution grammar in games, electric power grids, and scheduling. The release reproduces the 6,036,001-state WRRA Game 1.0 exact result and adds exhaustive finite grid and scheduling experiments. Across all three domains the certified Renderer produces zero exact objective-value mismatches while reducing the declared within-domain work. Reachable same-visible-state witnesses show that omitted residue can change legality, safety, transition cost, or exact value. The archive includes code, tests, a frozen analysis plan, machine-readable Ledgers, figures, and a technical report.
